# Leadzap Marketing

> Leadzap Marketing Sdn Bhd is a digital marketing agency in Malaysia offering
> SEO, Google Ads, social media marketing, and custom software and ERP
> development. Leadzap works with Malaysian businesses that want measurable
> leads — calls, WhatsApp enquiries and form submissions — rather than
> impressions alone.

- Site: https://leadzap.com.my/
- Based in: Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia (16-1, Jln SS19/6, SS 19, 47500)
- Contact: sales@leadzap.com.my, +60-111-1335119
- Office hours: Monday to Friday, 09:00–18:00 (Malaysia time)
- Primary market and language: Malaysia, English

## What Leadzap does

- **SEO and Google Ads (SEM)** — search visibility, organic traffic and paid
  search campaigns for Malaysian businesses. https://leadzap.com.my/sem/
- **Social media marketing and paid social ads** — content, campaign management
  and paid social. https://leadzap.com.my/social-media-ads/
- **Custom software and ERP** — bespoke systems, ERP, CRM and business
  automation built in Malaysia. https://leadzap.com.my/custom-software/
- **Order management system** — order workflow automation.
  https://leadzap.com.my/order-management/

## Commonly asked, answered

- **How is Leadzap's management fee structured?** The management fee covers
  strategy and positioning, campaign setup, creatives, tracking setup, ongoing
  optimisation and monthly reporting. For Google Ads + SEO it also includes
  website/landing page creation. Ad budgets are paid separately, directly to the
  advertising platforms.
- **How long do results take?** Paid ads typically show initial results within
  2–4 weeks. SEO is longer term: early movement in month 2–3, stronger rankings
  by month 4–6, and compounding growth from month 6–12. Results vary by
  competition and industry.
- **What ad budget does Leadzap recommend?** At least RM 2,000 per month per
  platform for meaningful results.
- **What does Leadzap report on?** Primary KPIs are leads (calls, WhatsApp,
  forms) or e-commerce sales; secondary metrics include cost per lead, cost per
  acquisition, conversion rate, lead quality and ROAS.
- **How long does custom software take to build?** Most MVPs launch in 6–8
  weeks; full systems take 3–6 months, with a prototype possible in 2 weeks.
